title: Lily
html_source: The opening word, and character in Joyce’s “The Dead”. The lily is a metaphor for multiple associations in Ireland: The Feast of the Annunciation, Easter, death and re-birth, Irish republicanism, the angel Gabriel, and the funeral flower.
